NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Family - specifications
sources.origin: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 40 Series product page
sources.notes: Total Graphics Power 200 W. NVIDIA states the table describes the Founders Edition / reference design and that add-in-board specifications may vary by manufacturer. This figure is therefore chip-level, not an ASUS-published board figure.

sources.title: Fractal Design North (Black TG Dark) - specifications
LIAN LI A3-mATX - specifications and hardware compatibility charts
sources.notes: The specification table (GPU LENGTH CLEARANCE, CPU HEIGHT CLEARANCE, PSU SUPPORT, MOTHERBOARD SUPPORT, CASE DIMENSIONS) is machine-readable text on the page. The HARDWARE COMPATIBILITY IN ALL CONFIGURATIONS charts, which carry the per-position GPU-length branches, are published as images (for example a3-h-030c.webp) with no alt text and no text transcription; the branch figures recorded from them were read off the rendered images by the repository owner, and automated re-reading of the page will not reproduce them. The page's Specifications list A3-mATX BLACK and A3-mATX WHITE as separate MODEL NO. / COLOR variants, so the black variant is a named SKU on this source rather than an assumption.

sources.title: Noctua NH-D15 G2 - Specifications
sources.notes: Covers the Standard base-convexity, brown NH-D15 G2 only. Noctua publishes NH-D15 G2 LBC, NH-D15 G2 HBC and NH-D15 G2 chromax.black as separate products with their own specification pages; figures from this page must not be applied to those SKUs. The page lists NSPR, EAN and UPC but no manufacturer part number.

sources.title: Noctua FAQ - How can I ensure both case and RAM compatibility with my NH-D15 (G2)?
sources.notes: Source for the 32 mm out-of-box RAM clearance at the default 168 mm cooler height, and for the rule that raising the front fan to clear taller memory increases total cooler height by the same amount. Supports invariant I6. It is referenced from the part's notes rather than from provenance, because cat6 has no provenance key for the notes field.

sources.title: AMD Ryzen 5 7600 Desktop Processor - product specifications
sources.notes: Covers the boxed SKU (Product ID Boxed 100-100001015BOX); the tray SKU 100-000001015 is a different product. The page publishes no CPU package width, length or height. CCD Size 71mm2 and IOD Size 122mm2 are silicon die areas, not package dimensions, and cannot substitute for them.

sources.title: AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D Desktop Processor - product specifications
sources.notes: Covers the boxed SKU (Product ID Boxed 100-100000910WOF); the tray SKU 100-000000910 is a different product. As with the Ryzen 5 7600, the page publishes no CPU package dimensions, and the CCD and IOD figures are silicon die areas rather than package dimensions.

sources.title: ASUS ProArt GeForce RTX 4080 OC Edition 16GB GDDR6X - Tech Specs
sources.notes: Board-partner source. It publishes this SKU's own dimensions, boost clocks and slot width. It does not publish a board power figure; the card's TGP is cited separately to NVIDIA under C10.

sources.title: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 Family - specifications
sources.origin: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 40 Series product page
sources.notes: Total Graphics Power 320 W, Required System Power 750 W. This is NVIDIA's chip-level figure for the RTX 4080, not a figure ASUS publishes for the ProArt board. It is recorded under C10, which permits a chip-vendor figure in compatSpec provided it is cited to the chip vendor and the scope caveat is kept here rather than being presented as the board partner's own specification.

sources.title: GIGABYTE B650 AORUS ELITE AX V2 - specifications
sources.notes: Highest explicitly listed memory rate is DDR5-8000(OC), recorded under C14 as a catalog ceiling. Board outline is published as two figures (30.5cm x 24.4cm) with no thickness. The page differentiates the Wi-Fi module by PCB rev. 1.0 / 1.1; no catalogued field depends on that difference.

sources.title: GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX (Rev. 1.3) - specifications
sources.notes: Revision-specific page. GIGABYTE publishes separate pages for revisions 1.0/1.1, 1.2, 1.3 and 1.4 under one model name; these figures apply to Rev. 1.3 only and must not be read across revisions. Highest explicitly listed memory rate is DDR5-8000(OC), recorded under C14. Board outline is published as two figures (24.4cm x 24.4cm) with no thickness.

sources.title: ASUS TUF GAMING B860M-PLUS WIFI - Tech Specs
sources.notes: Socket LGA1851, chipset Intel B860, DDR5, mATX. The memory ceiling is published as 'Support up to 8800+MT/s (OC)'; the trailing '+' means the page states a floor for the overclocking ceiling rather than an exact maximum, so it is not recorded as maxMemorySpeedMtS. Board outline is published as two figures (24.4cm x 24.4cm) with no thickness.

sources.title: Corsair RMe Series RM750e Fully Modular Low-Noise ATX Power Supply (CP-9020295-NA)
sources.notes: SKU-specific page for CP-9020295-NA. Corsair has shipped other RM750e SKUs, including CP-9020262; their figures are not interchangeable with these.

sources.title: Cooler Master V550 SFX Gold 550W (MPY-5501-SFHAGV)
sources.notes: The 550 W rating appears in the product title itself. Form factor SFX with an included SFX-to-ATX bracket; compat2 models no PSU form factor, so that fact is kept in the part's notes.

sources.title: TEAMGROUP T-CREATE EXPERT U-DIMM DDR5 Black 32GB (2x16GB) 6000MHz CL30 (CTCED532G6000HC30DC01)
sources.notes: Publishes all three module dimensions with labels -- 32(H) x 133(L) x 7(W) mm -- which is what allows dimensionsMm to be authored here where it could not be for the G.SKILL kit. The 32 mm height is the figure invariant I6 rests on.

sources.title: G.SKILL Trident Z5 RGB DDR5-8400 48GB (2x24GB) White - specification (F5-8400J4052G24GX2-TZ5RW)
sources.notes: SKU-specific page for the TZ5RW white variant; TZ5RK is a different SKU. Tested speed 8400 MT/s at 1.40V with SPD speed 5600 MT/s at 1.10V -- the rated figure is recorded, not the SPD fallback. G.SKILL states that reaching the rated speed requires overclocking and BIOS adjustment and depends on the CPU and motherboard. The page publishes no module length or thickness.

sources.title: ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 4060 OC Edition 8GB GDDR6 - Tech Specs
sources.notes: Dimensions and boost clock are unlabeled/labeled per the page as recorded on the part. ASUS separately sells DUAL-RTX4060-O8G-V2 and DUAL-RTX4060-O8G-WHITE as distinct SKUs with their own pages; their figures are not interchangeable with this one.

sources.title: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti & RTX 4060 - specifications
sources.origin: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 40 Series product page
sources.notes: Total Graphics Power row: RTX 4060 Ti '165 or 160' W (the published table does not split this by 8GB/16GB memory configuration); RTX 4060 '115' W, a single unambiguous figure. Only the RTX 4060 figure is used in this catalog (gpu.asus-dual-rtx4060-o8g); no RTX 4060 Ti SKU is catalogued from this source, because recording either 165 or 160 would assert a precision the source does not give. NVIDIA states specifications vary by add-in-card manufacturer; this is a chip-level figure, not a board-partner figure.

sources.title: ASUS TUF GAMING B650-PLUS WIFI - Tech Specs
sources.notes: Socket AM5, chipset AMD B650, DDR5, ATX. Memory speed list published as '7600+(OC)/ 7200(OC)/ 7000(OC)/ 6800(OC)/6600(OC)/ 6400(OC)/ 6200(OC)/ 6000(OC)/ 5800(OC)/ 5600(OC)/ 5400(OC)/ 5200/ 5000/ 4800'; the leading figure's trailing '+' means the page states a floor for the overclocking ceiling rather than an exact maximum (same reading as the B860M's '8800+MT/s'), so maxMemorySpeedMtS is not recorded on the part — absence is better than inventing an exact ceiling (C1, C14). Board outline is published as two figures (30.5cm x 24.4cm) with no thickness.

sources.title: Fractal Design Meshify 2 Compact - specifications
sources.notes: Case dimensions are labeled '(LxWxH)' on the page: 424 x 210 x 475 mm. GPU max length 341 mm (360 mm without front fan); CPU cooler max height 169 mm; PSU max length 200 mm (165 mm with HDD cage and front fan); motherboard compatibility ATX / mATX / Mini-ITX, of which compat2 models only ATX and Micro-ATX.

sources.title: NZXT H5 Flow - specifications
sources.notes: Case dimensions are labeled '(H x W x D)' on the page: 465 x 225 x 430 mm. GPU length up to 410 mm; CPU cooler height up to 170 mm; PSU length up to 200 mm, each printed as a plain ceiling with no configuration-dependent branch. Motherboard support E-ATX (up to 277 mm), ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX, of which compat2 models only ATX and Micro-ATX.

sources.title: CORSAIR RMe Series RM850e Fully Modular Low-Noise ATX Power Supply (CP-9020263-NA)
sources.notes: SKU-specific page for CP-9020263-NA. Dimensions are printed as an unlabeled triplet '140x150x86' with no separate 'Length' row on this page; the length assignment on the part record is derived by comparison with the RM750e sibling SKU (source.cat6.corsair.rm750e-cp-9020295-na.product), which does separately label Length as 140mm and shares the identical 140x150x86 triplet as a same-series (RMe) chassis. Wattage 850 W; 80 PLUS Gold; ATX 3.1; PCIe 5.1 compliant; fully modular.

sources.title: DeepCool AK620 - High Performance CPU Cooler
sources.notes: Dimensions labeled '(L x W x H)': product/with-fans 129x138x160 mm (used on the part record as the installed envelope), heatsink-only 127x110x157 mm (not used, matching the with-fan convention already applied to the Noctua NH-D15 G2). Socket compatibility AM5/AM4 plus a list of Intel sockets. RAM clearance 43 mm dual-fan / 59 mm single-fan mode. Maximum heat dissipation (TDP rating) 260 W. Weight 1456 g.

sources.title: Cooler Master Hyper 212 Halo Black
sources.notes: Dimensions labeled '(L x W x H)': 124 x 73 x 154 mm. Socket compatibility AM5/AM4 plus a list of Intel sockets. 4 heat pipes; one 120mm ARGB fan. The page publishes no weight and no TDP/heat-dissipation rating; neither is recorded.

sources.title: TEAMGROUP T-CREATE EXPERT U-DIMM DDR5 Black 64GB (2x32GB) 6000MHz CL34 (CTCED564G6000HC34BDC01)
sources.notes: Publishes the same labelled module dimensions as the 32GB CL30 sibling SKU -- 32(H) x 133(L) x 7(W) mm -- since both are the same physical module/heatspreader design at a different DRAM density. Capacity 64GB (2x32GB); CAS latency CL34; voltage 1.35V; Intel XMP3.0 and AMD EXPO supported.

sources.title: G.SKILL FAQ - DRAM Memory
sources.notes: Source for the Trident Z5 RGB module height of 44mm and for the DDR5 part-number suffix convention in which W denotes White. It publishes height only, not length or thickness, so it cannot complete a DimensionsMm. Referenced from the part's notes rather than from provenance, because cat6 has no provenance key for the notes field.
